name: snapper-mcp
description: Connects Claude Code / Claude Desktop to a Snapper trading backend via the /api/mcp endpoint. Ships a watch subcommand that streams live signal + order events as JSONL, auto-wired as a Claude Code plugin monitor sharing the same long-lived AI delegate token as the proxy MCP server.

SNAPPER_BASE_URL.title: Snapper API URL
SNAPPER_BASE_URL.description: Your Snapper backend MCP endpoint, e.g. https://snapper.example.com/api/mcp - generate from Snapper's AI Integration settings page.

SNAPPER_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Access token
SNAPPER_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Long-lived AI delegate JWT. Paste from Snapper's AI Integration config-snippet generator. The same token authenticates both the proxy MCP server and the watch monitor.

monitors.name: snapper-watch
monitors.description: Live Snapper signal + order events streamed as JSONL
